checks.interpretation: Batch GET is collection query with batchId; item route is not the read endpoint.
Item route permits PATCH/DELETE, not GET.
Ownership gate precedes lifecycle; anonymous identity error is 400; deleted/expired410, failed409, binary missing503.
Completeness applies to all selected checks; machine-only and high-risk/limited sources do not become eligible merely by approval.
Normal review UI supports append-only actions with conservative retry and restoration of decision meaning.
Versioned product name/SKU update through standard editor; preserve the remaining profile.
Archive/restore is reversible; current conflict is resolved by reviewing latest before resubmission.
Free UI gate and bounded search/retry are distinct from authenticated export HTTP behavior.

rationale: No runtime difference from deployed baseline; bound developer originals and limited source checks reused. Fresh production counterexample independently observed; full unchanged suites not rerun.
limitations: Source inspection is not production session, paid entitlement, asset HTTP410, frozen JSON identity, or double-account write proof.
